Here is your form (P1 only), filled from what you gave me.

Important first: your daughter's passport expires on 1 January 2027, before you arrive on 20 April 2027. Japan will not issue her a visa on that passport, so she needs a new one before her application. Her passport number and dates of issue and expiry will change, so update her stored details once she has it. Your passport (valid to 4 June 2029) and your wife's (valid to 10 August 2030) are fine.

Things to fix by hand once your details are put back:
- B04 and B14: the form wants Day/Month/Year. If your passport prints these dates in another shape (for example "15 MAR 1988"), rewrite them as DD/MM/YYYY.
- B05: the form wants city, state or province, and country as separate parts. If your stored place of birth is only a city, add the state and country yourself.
- B27: if your number is stored without the country code, add +91 in front. If it is a mobile, you can leave the Tel. box blank or keep it there too. If you have a separate landline, put that in Tel.

What's missing (marked NEEDS-YOU):
- B03: any other names you use or have used. Write "None" if there aren't any.
- B09: any former or other nationality. Write "None" if there isn't one.
- B10: your government ID number. I don't have it, so write it on the form yourself; don't type it here. If the consulate doesn't ask for one, leave it blank.
- B11: tick the passport type. A regular Indian passport (type "P") is "Ordinary", but check yours.
- B13: copy "Place of Issue" from your passport. It's a separate line from the issuing authority.
- B22: your airline, and flight number if you have one.
- B23 and B24: name, phone number and address of your hotel (the first one, if you stay at several).
- B25: if you know the exact dates of your October 2023 visit, add them (for example "DD/10/2023 to DD/10/2023, 9 days").
- B28: your email address.
- B29: change the position if your actual title is different (for example "Senior Software Engineer").
- B30 and B31: your employer's name, phone number and address.
- B33 and B34: for a self-funded holiday with no one hosting you in Japan, these are usually left blank or marked "None". Fill them in only if someone in Japan is guaranteeing or inviting you.
- B36 to B41: these are your own declaration, so tick Yes or No yourself. If any answer is Yes, explain in B42.
- B43 and B44: date and sign by hand on the day you submit.

B35 is optional, so you can leave it out. Your wife and daughter each need their own form. Your daughter's should wait until she has her new passport.
